before: "limitation": "All 33 common effects and three SPECIAL definitions/obtain behavior plus Warped Tongs turn hook are integrated offline. Treasure/shop still use restricted local selection; the complete source queue is wired to event preparation, not treasure/shop. Missing non-common definitions cause atomic refusal, never effect-based rerolls. SPECIAL are event-only legal channels and treasure candidates now admit only common/uncommon/rare, retaining the existing gold fallback when none are legal. Spirit Poop total-score deduction has only a helper and no production score consumer. Natural acquisition and platform/live evidence remain pending."
after: "limitation": "All 142 canonical relic definitions are integrated offline, including the complete 130-identity Ironclad source mother queues used by treasure, shop and event preparation with source eligibility. SPECIAL relics retain explicit channels. Spirit Poop total-score deduction has only a helper and no production score consumer. Controlled offline coverage does not establish natural acquisition, native per-item, complete-run execution or device acceptance; platform/live evidence remain pending."
